footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 1.0 x 0.8 mm body, 0.35 x 0.40 mm pads (Abracon ABM14)
footprints.note: Abracon ABM14 "Recommended Land Pattern" (datasheets/crystal/abracon/ABM14.pdf p.3): pads 0.40 x 0.35, gap 0.30 between pad columns, gap 0.20 between pad rows (dimension "0.30" is the gap, "4X 0.40" the pad width, "4X 0.35" the pad height; cross-checked against the 1.0 x 0.8 body outline). Centres: x = +-(0.30/2+0.40/2) = +-0.35, y = +-(0.20/2+0.35/2) = +-0.275. Datasheet land pattern is drawn in the part's top-view orientation (pad 1 bottom-left); turned 90 degrees clockwise so pad 1 is top-left (dual numbering): datasheet pad width/height swap, datasheet x-centre distance becomes the pitch and y-centre distance the span. Result: span 2 x 0.275 = 0.55, pitch 2 x 0.35 = 0.70, pad 0.35 x 0.40. Same-series ABM14N (ABM14N.pdf p.3) draws 0.42 x 0.33 pads, gaps 0.21 / 0.19 (not equal; this footprint is the ABM14 drawing). Hand check: pad centres recomputed from the printed dimensions above and matched to span / pitch / pad size.

Centres x = +-(2.68/2+2.4/2) = +-2.54, y = +-(2.1/2+2.3/2) = +-2.2. The drawing is not to scale horizontally. Datasheet land pattern is drawn in the part's top-view orientation (pad 1 bottom-left); turned 90 degrees clockwise so pad 1 is top-left (dual numbering): datasheet pad width/height swap, datasheet x-centre distance becomes the pitch and y-centre distance the span. Result: span 2 x 2.2 = 4.4, pitch 2 x 2.54 = 5.08, pad 2.3 x 2.4. Pads 1,2 are the two adjacent pads on one long side (pinout 1=X1,2=X2). Hand check: pad centres recomputed from the printed dimensions above and matched to span / pitch / pad size.

Centres x = +-(0.31/2+0.52/2) = +-0.415, y = +-(0.25/2+0.45/2) = +-0.35. The land pattern carries no numbers; read as a top view like the part outline (top view: #2 top-left, #1 top-right, #3 bottom-left, #4 bottom-right; bottom view of the same page is its mirror). Numbering turned 90 degrees counter-clockwise so pad 1 (top-right) lands top-left: pad 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right, 4 top-right. Result: span 2 x 0.35 = 0.70, pitch 2 x 0.415 = 0.83, pad 0.45 x 0.52. Hand check: pad centres recomputed from the printed dimensions above and matched to span / pitch / pad size.
